scope: 3 sword-cut contact poses × 4 external directions; newly generated individual reference PNGs
label_ko: AI 생성 자세 참고 — 실제 게임 촬영이나 AI 생성 영상이 아님
processing: 선택된 원본 PNG를 바이트 그대로 복사. 자르기·좌우반전·색보정·콜라주·컨택트시트·이미지 합성 없음. 원본 경로 보존.

direction_convention.left: 외부 카메라가 인물의 왼쪽. 가까운 팔은 방패팔, 얼굴·몸통 화면 오른쪽.
direction_convention.right: 외부 카메라가 인물의 오른쪽. 가까운 팔은 검팔, 얼굴·몸통 화면 왼쪽.
direction_convention.top: 외부 카메라가 위에서 아래를 향함. 정수리·어깨 윗면 확인. 인물 화면 전방 방향은 개별 검수에 기록.
direction_convention.bottom: 외부 카메라가 아래에서 위를 향함. 턱·전완·검 가드 아랫면 확인.

limitations_ko: 독립 생성 원본들이므로 카메라 정확한 수치·인물 얼굴·가죽 버클 세부·관절 각도가 모든 방향에서 완전히 동일하지 않다.
외부 측면은 반대편 팔이 몸통이나 방패에 가려질 수 있다. 손목의 가려진 세부는 다른 방향과 실제 게임 촬영으로 검증해야 한다.
정적 중간 자세 참고이며 정확히 동일한 3D 자세의 다중 카메라 렌더나 연속 동작의 증거가 아니다.

attempts.prompt_exact: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a NEW single-frame photoreal medieval game animation modeling reference, not a screenshot of the implemented game. Input image 1 is appearance/material reference ONLY; input image 2 gives the instant of the right-diagonal sword cut ONLY. Generate a wholly new external-camera image; do not crop, mirror, recycle, or reproduce the POV framing of either reference. Exactly ONE adult fighter, ONE frozen contact-phase pose, ONE camera direction, ONE image. Tight upper-body view including connected shoulders, chest, both elbows and both wrists, plus the sword and shield; legs are unnecessary. The fighter's anatomical RIGHT hand holds the slender straight double-edged arming sword with straight crossguard and dark wrapped one-hand grip; anatomical LEFT hand and forearm hold the round dark oak shield with thin iron rim. Worn charcoal leather sleeves, two thin buckled forearm straps, fingerless dark gloves with visible fingers; match the references' identity, materials and moody dark studio lighting. The action is the MIDDLE/contact instant of a right-to-left descending diagonal cut: right fist extended in front at lower chest height, sword traversing toward the fighter's left, blade slightly above horizontal and cutting down-left; left shield low beside the torso. No final low follow-through, no kneeling, no second person. Natural plausible shoulder-elbow-wrist chain and firm grip. Single landscape 16:9 composition. No panel, collage, montage, inset, split-screen, sequence, labels, arrows, ghost trails, HUD, or text. CAMERA IS TRUE EXTERNAL LEFT PROFILE, on the fighter's anatomical LEFT side at shoulder height, looking sideways across the whole torso. The fighter's nose, chest and attack direction face toward the RIGHT EDGE OF THE IMAGE. The LEFT shield arm is nearest the external camera, the RIGHT sword arm is farther away. Show a plainly recognizable left side of head/neck/torso and visible shoulder-to-elbow connections. The camera is several feet outside the body, not behind the eyes and not behind either arm. Opposite-side (right profile) or first-person pictures are incorrect.

visual_qa.review_method: 원본 이미지를 직접 육안 검토; 자동 유사도 점수 없음
visual_qa.notes_ko: 가까운 팔이 검팔로 생성되어 의도한 LEFT의 방패팔 전경 조건에 맞지 않음.

attempts.prompt_exact: Create ONE NEW photoreal medieval animation reference image, ONE adult male fighter at ONE frozen right-diagonal-cut CONTACT pose from ONE external camera. Inputs are materials and contact-position references ONLY, never copy their first-person camera. Charcoal leather sleeves, two thin buckled forearm straps, fingerless black gloves; slender straight arming sword in anatomical RIGHT hand; round dark oak shield with narrow iron rim in anatomical LEFT hand and forearm. Match the dark studio stone-ground look and equipment of the input references. Upper body close-up with crown or chin, chest, both shoulders, connected elbows, wrists, sword and shield. Middle/contact of a descending right-to-left diagonal cut, right fist held FORWARD around chest height, blade traversing to the fighter's anatomical left. Shield held at left flank. Not low finished follow-through. Natural human anatomy, exactly two hands. ONE full landscape image, no panels, no collage, no inset, no extra pose, no text or labels. STRICT 90-DEGREE LEFT SIDE PROFILE. Detached camera stands beside the fighter's anatomical LEFT shoulder. The torso, sternum and nose all point HORIZONTALLY toward the RIGHT edge of the image. Only the left side profile of the head and narrow side of torso are visible, NOT the full chest facing camera. The anatomical LEFT shoulder/LEFT elbow and LEFT SHIELD arm are the NEAR foreground limb. The round SHIELD and its left forearm clearly occlude the farther RIGHT SWORD arm. The right sword hand appears beyond/above the shield as the far-side arm reaches forward. The near arm MUST hold the shield, not the sword. If the sword arm is nearest the camera this is the wrong side. The right-diagonal cut crosses toward the camera slightly, with natural blade foreshortening. This is a new external LEFT-side camera image, absolutely not a POV image.
